topics.title: Nature of memory: encoding, storage and retrieval

concepts.learning_objective: Describe memory as the three interrelated stages of encoding, storage and retrieval.

topics.title: The stage model: sensory, short-term and long-term memory
topics.ncert_sections: Information Processing Approach: The Stage Model; Memory Systems

concepts.learning_objective: Compare the capacity, duration and encoding of sensory, short-term and long-term memory in the Atkinson-Shiffrin model.
Explain how attention, maintenance rehearsal, chunking and elaborative rehearsal move information between stores.

topics.title: Working memory and evaluation of the stage model

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the phonological loop, visuospatial sketchpad and central executive in Baddeley's working memory.
Evaluate evidence such as the case of KF that questions separate STM and LTM stores.
Explain Craik and Lockhart's structural, phonetic and semantic levels of processing and their effect on retention.

topics.title: Types of long-term memory
topics.ncert_sections: Types of Long-term Memory; Box 6.2; Box 6.3

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish declarative from procedural memory with examples.
Distinguish Tulving's episodic and semantic memory.
Describe flashbulb, autobiographical and implicit memory and methods such as recall, recognition and priming.

topics.title: Nature and causes of forgetting
topics.ncert_sections: Nature and Causes of Forgetting; Box 6.4

concepts.learning_objective: Interpret Ebbinghaus's curve of forgetting and evaluate trace decay theory.
Explain forgetting due to absent or inappropriate retrieval cues.

topics.title: Enhancing memory
topics.ncert_sections: Enhancing Memory; Mnemonics using Images and Organisation

concepts.learning_objective: Apply the keyword method and the method of loci.
Apply chunking and the first letter technique to organise material.
Explain deep processing, minimising interference, retrieval cues and the PQRST method.
